## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to reason with Kleene 3-valued logic in rule-based constraints and design a backtracking propagation strategy.

## Key Concepts
- Kleene 3-valued semantics
- Implication as ¬X ∨ Y
- Unit propagation and backtracking
- Ensuring at least one U while avoiding F

## Code Example
```javascript
function not(x){ return x==='T'?'F': x==='F'?'T':'U'; }
function or(x,y){ const order={F:0,U:1,T:2}; return (order[x] >= order[y])? x : y; }
function imp(a,b){ return or(not(a), b); }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale to ~20 vars and more complex rules?
- What heuristics minimize backtracks in practice?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of 3-valued semantics and practical constraint propagation.

## Key Concepts
- Kleene values: T>U>F; NOT U = U; A->B := NOT A OR B; backtracking to avoid F.
- Goal: no constraint evaluates to F while at least one U remains.

## Code Example
```javascript
function not(x){ return x==='T'?'F':x==='F'?'T':'U'; }
function impl(a,b){ // A->B  = NOT A OR B
  const na = not(a);
  const order = {'F':0,'U':1,'T':2};
  return order[na] > order[b] ? na : b;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How scale to more variables? 
- Detect unsatisfiable rule sets efficiently?
